title: Federated user mention textual form (@user@host)
description:
Formalize the textual `@user@host` form for federated user mentions, parallel to ActivityPub / Mastodon conventions.

The spec already implicitly supports federated user IDs in the value space (the rich-body example at line 1296 shows `userId: "user:alice@example.com"`), but does not specify:
- How the textual form `@alice@example.com` is parsed by clients
- How clients resolve the textual form to a ChatContact.id
- How server-side mention validation handles federated mentions
- Whether the federated mention triggers any peer-side resolution before send

Blocked on the broadcast-scope mention epic (depends on the Mention type discriminator infrastructure that epic establishes — federated user mentions will be `type: "user"` with a federated id value, vs. a broadcast scope).

Additionally depends conceptually on the federation draft's contact-resolution maturity — at present the federation draft handles delivery to known peers but doesn't define "resolve this textual handle to a peer". That gap may need filling before this epic can fully land.
